title: The Black Death
key_facts: Pandemic of bubonic plague that killed tens of millions across Eurasia
Spread along trade routes including the Silk Road and Mediterranean maritime networks
Caused profound demographic, economic, religious, and cultural shifts
causes: Yersinia pestis bacterium transmitted by fleas carried by rodents
High urban density and limited sanitation in medieval towns
Extensive interregional trade facilitating rapid transmission
outcome: Mass mortality (often estimated at 30–60% in affected regions)
Labor shortages contributing to wage pressures and social mobility
Religious and social upheavals; persecution of minorities in some areas

figures.name: Ibn Battuta
figures.role: Traveler whose era overlapped the pandemic

impacts: Restructuring of feudal economies and changes in land/labor relations
Shifts in religious practices and art; rise of lay piety and confraternities
Public health responses and quarantines emerge in later outbreaks
